tasks.title: Shared reads bound Bun response memory, refuse redirects and emit fixed parser and wire errors
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, Behavior 1-6, all Tests and Completion evidence; Decisions 1-5, 7-8, Required behavior R1-R5, Counterexamples, Performance impact, Security impact, Rollout order 1 and Acceptance evidence (whole feature) 1-4. Implement one shared request-init helper and Bun encoding check, fixed parse/wire texts, matching regressions, docs, version 2.5.2 and regenerated dist as one cohesive fix. Preserve public types/result shapes, wire version 1, default 5 MiB/custom cap, timeout/abort/first-interruption/cancellation behavior, manual-incident helpers and requestJson's bounded ErrorResponse.error handling. Add no source module or dist-module import; no runtime/dev dependency or setting. Include dist/client.d.ts because the changed exported-function doc comments are emitted there; other dist outputs change only if regenerated by build.

acceptance.command: git checkout 1b5e7d3e268372a6241db05ae30272eab7299b10 -- src && bun test test/client-memory.test.ts test/client-transport.test.ts test/client.test.ts test/request-json.test.ts test/version.test.ts
acceptance.expected: Run with new/changed tests before implementing the fix; retain the red output. Assertions fail for memory growth over the literal 64 MiB budget, followed redirects (ok true, destination count 1) and both upstream-text leaks. Report failing test names and all three peakGrowthMiB values, then restore candidate src before green checks. A focused suite may also fail coverage; coverage alone is not red evidence.

All 3 memory cases pass, 0 fail on the fix: native Bun fetchJson 200 -> network, fetchJson 500 -> http, requestJson POST 200 with '{}' -> network, each peakGrowthMiB < 64. Sequential isolated children use process.execPath, ../src/index.ts, 30 s kill deadlines and 60 s test timeout. Stream one 1 MiB block of spaces 256 times through createBrotliCompress with BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY explicitly 1; never allocate the decoded 256 MiB fixture or use default quality 11. After fixture generation/server startup, Bun.gc(true) precedes RSS baseline; sample every 5 ms during the call and for 1000 ms afterward, round growth down in MiB and print {kind,peakGrowthMiB}. Quality 1 fixture measured 48,289 bytes and 0.04-0.06 CPU s in the spec. Focused coverage exit is not the gate.

All transport assertions pass, 0 fail; native Bun fetch against 127.0.0.1:0 refuses same-origin 302, cross-origin 301/307 and 303/308: ok false, http with the literal 3xx status, destination request count 0 despite x-api-key marker. TLS-to-HTTP 302 (also the 307 Counterexample) gives http with that status and 0 destination requests. Generate a test-only EC P-256 certificate in mkdtemp via execFileSync('openssl', [...], {stdio:'ignore'}), using kit's exact sonarjs/no-os-command-from-path suppression/comment, -subj /CN=127.0.0.1 -addext subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1 -days 2; trust only its ca through a wrapper spreading init. OpenSSL availability is evidenced by the spec's ubuntu-24.04 runner image and passing kit TLS CI; missing openssl fails, never skips. Close servers/remove certificate directory; commit no keys. Under Bun gzip, br, deflate, zstd, x-unknown and 'identity, gzip' give network with Error cause 'response content-encoding is not supported', no header text in serialized result and no validator call; absent, empty, identity and space/case variants read normally. Assert accept-encoding identity at server. Identity Content-Length and chunked bodies above the default 5 MiB cap give too-large; a small gzip body with maxBytes 1 MiB is network. Precedence: wire 2 + 200 + br -> wire-mismatch, 503 + br -> http 503, requestJson 412 + gzip ErrorResponse -> http 412 without message. Focused coverage exit is not the gate.

All assertions pass, 0 fail. Both client functions give invalid-json.message exactly 'response body is not valid JSON' for two malformed bodies with different markers; neither marker appears in JSON.stringify(result). Headers '2' and a 4000-character marker value give exactly 'x-pulse-contract: unsupported wire version, expected 1' at GET 200 wire-mismatch.message, GET 500 error.wire.error, write 2xx error.message/response.wire.error and write 422 error.wire.error (and response metadata); no marker survives serialization. Version tests also assert that literal for empty header and retain existing ok/absent/mismatch comparison cases. Injected-fetch assertions verify manual redirects, decompress false, accept-encoding identity overriding caller gzip, retained authorization and signal, and unchanged write method/body/content-type. Read seen.headers with new Headers and replace the old checkWireVersion-derived expected message with the literal. Source-import regression forbids node:/bun imports in client.ts/version.ts. Existing timeout, abort, cancellation, validation, empty write and body-limit tests stay passing. Focused coverage exit is not the gate.

acceptance.command: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check && bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: exit 0 after committing regenerated dist; lint, build, typecheck, full tests (including independent dist rebuild in test/smoke.test.ts) and unchanged >=80% line coverage pass. Fresh build has no diff from committed dist. Only package version moves from 2.5.1 to 2.5.2; no new dependencies. Generated declarations introduce no new names or decompress option.

acceptance.command: git diff main -- src/client.ts src/version.ts README.md docs/index.md package.json dist
acceptance.expected: Diff implements Behavior 1-6: shared local RequestInit & {decompress?:boolean} helper supplies signal, redirect manual, decompress false and identity header set last to both functions; Bun-only encoding check runs before any body read and drops refused bodies without waiting. Existing status/wire precedence and requestJson non-2xx fixed handling are preserved; readText/dropBody/interruptible and public types remain unchanged. No new src module or import between dist modules. README/docs add console to consumer/pin lists, version 2.5.2 patch note, both fixed texts, request init/check order, Bun encoding/network and non-2xx write rules, Node/browser capped decoding, visible 3xx HTTP status and browser opaque redirect HTTP status 0; browser identity restriction is stated.
No output (grep exit 1 for no matches); neither browser-used source imports node: or bun modules.

Create the uncommitted evidence script in a scratch directory outside the repository per Completion evidence, use Node 24 and native fetch/node:http on 127.0.0.1:0, and report exact Node version and both outputs. Branch dist: identity {"a":1} -> ok true/value {"a":1}; 302 -> http 302/destination count 0; brotli quality 1 of 256 MiB spaces -> too-large/peak RSS growth <64 MiB. Baseline dist at 1b5e7d3e268372a6241db05ae30272eab7299b10: 302 -> ok true/destination count 1. Fixtures/servers/scripts stay outside the committed change.

acceptance.command: cd <scratch>/browser && bun add playwright@1.64.1 && bunx playwright install chromium && bun build <branch-contract>/dist/index.js --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=contract.js && bun build <baseline-contract>/dist/index.js --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=contract-baseline.js && node browser-evidence.mjs
acceptance.expected: Create the uncommitted browser-evidence.mjs harness per Completion evidence in this scratch directory, outside contract. Serve page/bundle from node:http 127.0.0.1:0 and a second CORS-* destination; every response has x-pulse-contract 1. In Chromium call fetchJson with fetch.bind(globalThis), identity validation and timeoutMs 20000. Branch: /small gzip {"a":1} -> ok true/value {"a":1}; /big gzip level 9 of 256 MiB spaces and /bigbr brotli quality 1 of that body -> too-large; /same 302 and /cross 307 -> http status 0 and each destination count 0. Repeat using baseline 1b5e7d3 dist: /same and /cross -> ok true and each destination count 1. Report Chromium version, both sets of literal results and per-call times. This exercises the non-Bun decoded-stream path; a source-import check alone is insufficient. No browser dependency or harness is committed to contract.

acceptance.command: bash -c 'TIMEFORMAT="%U %S"; for run in 1 2 3; do time bun run test; done'
acceptance.expected: Run three times per side on unchanged main and candidate on the same machine with bash builtin time (not /usr/bin/time); report individual user+system sums and median per side. Spec expects contract.test_cpu_s delta +0.6 to +1.0 s, compared with API-owned budget 9.0 s and regression floor 2.0 s (B-A > max(A*10%,2.0) or B>9.0 fails). Above +1.5 s run the fallback harness and report its rows; do not lower gates.

Conditional on primary contract test CPU delta >1.5 s. Clone https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-api.git to <scratch>/pulse-api outside the target and run bun install --frozen-lockfile there first. Harness belongs to api, not contract or a consumer; replace both api-main-SHA arguments with the same concrete api main revision and target with contract. --b-ref uses a publicly fetchable pushed branch or SHA; --others-ref main is required. Docker with Compose is required. Record contract rows using the independently specified API bench/budgets.json/README failure rule.

acceptance.command: git diff --check && gh pr view --json body,statusCheckRollup
acceptance.expected: Whitespace check exits 0 and required CI checks pass, including install/lint/typecheck/build/clean-dist/full-tests and mandatory TLS tests. PR names #864 and version 2.5.2, records red failing names/RSS, green results, Node/Chromium baseline and branch outputs with versions/browser timings, CPU medians and conditional fallback rows. Complete Security impact checklist for no upstream text in specified errors, 5 MiB/custom memory bounds including early drops, no credential forwarding on redirects, closed unknown/combined encodings and unchanged dependency policy. State browser limit: it cannot request identity and relies on its streaming decoder inside the cap.
